abilities.descEn: Frequently avoids the effects of Ice Shot and Blizzard items.
abilities.descZh: 該Ranger能夠以高機率閃避「發射冰／暴風雪」的道具效果。

abilities.descEn: Rangers with this Ability won't be affected by charm effects.
abilities.descZh: 持有這個能力的Ranger不會受到誘惑效果影響。

abilities.descEn:
High chance of a missile being launched when deployed.
This Ability activating has no effect on the normal charge time of missiles.\n- Abilities with the same effect will not activate again for 5 seconds.\n- Rangers deploy 5 seconds after battles start.
abilities.descZh:
出動時能以高機率發射飛彈。
發動此能力時不會影響飛彈的充填時間。\n※效果相同的能力需間隔5秒才能再次發動。\n※此能力可於戰鬥開始5秒後發動。

abilities.descEn: Gives a high chance of increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed. This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
abilities.descZh: 出動擁有此能力的Ranger時，能以高機率增加敵方隊伍1隻Ranger的生產礦物成本。此能力可於戰鬥開始10秒後發動。
